sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mod 2.
The Petitioner in this writ petition prays for the following relief:

"It is therefore prayed this Hon'ble Court would graciously be pleased to admit this Writ Petition and issue RULE NISSI and issue notice to opposite parties to why not considering the representation under Annexure-8 which is pending before Opp. No.3 to pay fair & adequate compensation i.e. 100% intead of 10% as assured by the Opposite Parties against the damage of the structure of market complex Possessed by the petitioner in the interest of justice.
And further be pleased to pass such other order/orders, direction/directions deem fit & proper in the interest of justice, so as to give complete relief to the petitioner.
And for this act of your kindness the petitioner as in duty bound shall ever pray."
3. Mr. Mohanty, learned counsel submits that the Petitioner claims higher compensation.
